import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (colored by Sleep Disorder)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
sleep_disorder_present = df['Sleep Disorder'].notna() & (df['Sleep Disorder'] != '')
scatter_colors = ['#e74c3c' if x else '#3498db' for x in sleep_disorder_present]
ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], c=scatter_colors, alpha=0.6, s=100)
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax1.legend(['No Disorder', 'Has Disorder'], loc='best', fontsize=8)

# 2. Age Distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.hist(df['Age'], bins=15, color=colors[0], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax3.bar(bmi_counts.index, bmi_counts.values, color=colors[1:4], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax3.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax3.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 4. Physical Activity vs Stress Level
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
ax4.scatter(df['Physical Activity Level'], df['Stress Level'], 
            c=df['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6)
ax4.set_xlabel('Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_ylabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity vs Stress (colored by Age)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax4.collections[0], ax=ax4)
cbar.set_label('Age', fontsize=8)

# 5. Daily Steps Distribution
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.hist(df['Daily Steps'], bins=15, color=colors[4], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 6. Heart Rate by BMI Category
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
bmi_categories = df['BMI Category'].unique()
bmi_hr_data = [df[df['BMI Category'] == cat]['Heart Rate'].values for cat in bmi_categories]
bp = ax6.boxplot(bmi_hr_data, labels=bmi_categories, patch_artist=True)
for patch, color in zip(bp['boxes'], colors):
    patch.set_facecolor(color)
    patch.set_alpha(0.7)
ax6.set_xlabel('BMI Category', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Heart Rate', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Heart Rate by BMI Category', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.tick_params(axis='x', rotation=45)

# 7. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
sleep_disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').replace('', 'None').value_counts()
ax7.pie(sleep_disorder_counts.values, labels=sleep_disorder_counts.index, 
        autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors[:len(sleep_disorder_counts)], startangle=90)
ax7.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Occupation Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
occupation_counts = df['Occupation'].value_counts()
ax8.barh(occupation_counts.index, occupation_counts.values, color=colors[5:], alpha=0.7, edgecolor='black')
ax8.set_xlabel('Count', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Occupation', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Occupation Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8}, square=True, linewidths=0.5)
ax9.set_title('Correlation Heatmap', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax9.tick_params(axis='both', labelsize=8)

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
